decisions.reason: The generic rule that every active prize ticket follows the NFT remains valid for the continuing Small Block tickets; no Big-Block-specific attribute remains in this Requirement.
The source changes the $30 purchase allocation and removes Big Blocks, but does not change the $48 secondary royalty, its enforcement, or the rule that royalties fund the remaining prize pool.
Removing Big Blocks does not change deployment on Base.
The approved FAQ and fiat-buyer rewards section still describe Big Block tickets, $6,000 prizes, and the prior purchase allocation, so the product copy necessarily requires revision.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Marcus, please remove the big blocks and redirect that extra $8 to me. The new breakdown should be:
$30 purchase, $12 to me, $10 to the affiliate, and $8 to the block prize pool.

That should improve my bottom line without materially affecting sales, while also making the game mechanics and marketing simpler.

An even arrangement between me and each community member, together with an equal opportunity to win the continuing $900 prizes, feels consistent with the project's ethos.

value_updates.approved_faq_copy: Revise the approved FAQ copy to remove Big Block prizes and tickets, retain the continuing $900 Small Block prizes, and reflect the $30 purchase allocation of $12 to the creator, $10 to the affiliate, and $8 to the block prize pool.
value_updates.fiat_buyer_rewards_faq_section: Retain the fiat-buyer rewards FAQ section but remove Big Block and $6,000-draw references; describe prize tickets, notifications, and payouts only for the continuing $900 prizes.

decisions.reason: The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes big_block_ticket_lifecycle and narrows the contexts to the continuing Small Block ticket lifecycle.
The NFT token serial remains the permanent referral code and its display locations are unaffected by removal of Big Blocks.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already records the new $8 purchase allocation to the continuing prize pool, while the Small Block winner count, $900 award, and draw trigger remain unchanged.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes big_block_tickets_per_referral_mint, leaving the Small Block ticket issuance rule intact.
The source preserves the $10 affiliate allocation and does not change the no-referral commission trigger or recipient-selection rule.
The source does not change Transak, fiat conversion, wallet provisioning, or the deferred status of fiat minting.
The existing generic allocation of one ticket to a random existing NFT remains applicable to the continuing Small Block system and contains no obsolete Big-Block-specific key.
Removing Big Blocks does not change the NFT ebook format or unlimited edition supply.
